title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Aravind and Pandian express concern for Vannathi's health. Pandian questions Nadesan's constant presence at Sembaruthi's stall and asks him to sell the tempo he bought on loan.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj takes pride in his family outing, while Suresh is reluctant to invite Mathi to his function. Elsewhere, Lakshmi secretly plans a movie outing with Malar and Mathi.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 68: The OG Bigg Boss Returns
description: Hunger, heated clashes and heartfelt apologies fill the day. Later, BB’s emotional return and praise for the HMs and Junior BBs tops it off.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya confesses to mimicking Tamizhselvi's voice, shocking the family. Though Sethupathi asks her to leave, Mohana stops her to protect Sethupathi's reputation.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri teaches Karthik to dance for a competition. Meanwhile, Shyam fixes his register marriage with Madhu and voices concerns about Arjun to her father.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Sensing Kanmani needs help despite her hesitation, Anbu exits his meeting. He poses as press to get Kanmani and Thenmozhi inside the business expo finale.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy firmly opposes Lakshmi and the family's plan for a grand reception. Later, Ganesan explains its value as an investment, and Kandhasamy finally agrees to host it.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian shares Gomathi's complaints with Muthuvel before the wedding feast. Later, Muthuvel asks Vadivu about her feelings, only to face her list of complaints.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Believing Shruthi has ended her pregnancy, Ravi resorts to drinking. Moved by his pain, Shruthi reveals she is still pregnant, and the doctor confirms the truth.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
episodeTitle: Vetri Plans A Surprise For Abinaya
description: Vetri and Abinaya advise Sudar on friendship, while Divya and Prabhakaran reveal their love. Celebrating Abinaya's first writing paycheck, Vetri gifts her a name board.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi buys new appliances after Poongodi highlights the problems with the old ones. Concerned about theft, Azhagar volunteers to guard the garden through the night.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi hopes for a positive DNA result to establish Paraman as Viji's son. But the doctor reveals a mismatch, leaving her disappointed and raising suspicions of foul play.
